draft.summary: NFL.com graded him 5.65, the 253rd-best grade among 257 2024 draftees and 27th of 27 at tackle. He went 207th overall, well ahead of where his grade ranked (253rd): teams liked him more than the published grade. Testing was middle of the pack for his position, with no result in the top or bottom 20%.

current.summary: Year 3 pro, currently with the Atlanta Falcons. 11 career games and 3 starts over 2 completed seasons, plus 4 so far in 2026. Still developing: 0 AV in 2025. Weak spots: approximate value 0 (0th percentile). Played 1 of 17 games in 2025. Versus the typical Year-2 tackle who played: 2.9% season snap share against a median of 37.0%, below the norm.
